metadata.description: Marketplace for Rive Animator plugin - Code-first interactive Rive animations and State Machines

plugins.name: rive-animator
plugins.description: Code-first Rive toolkit for AI coding agents and developers: nine living recipes, a motion baker (flow, track, wave as exact keyframes), SVG and Lottie to RML, a linter for silent traps, a binary inspector, and runtime wiring for React, Vue, Svelte, Web Canvas, Flutter, SwiftUI, Android and React Native.
